speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have had a longstanding pruritic rash accompanied by numbness and tingling in your palms; can you tell me when these symptoms first began and if they are present on both hands?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC) with associated peripheral neuropathy and lichen planus. The combination of a pruritic rash on the upper body/face, sensory neuropathy in the palms, and exposure to livestock/rice farming suggests autoimmune liver disease with secondary complications. I will now request further testing to confirm this.

REQUEST TEST: Antimitochondrial Antibody (AMA), Liver Function Panel, and Electrolytes.
REQUEST IMAGES: Dermatology photos of the rash.
